text.p: Comdisco Inc., a computer leasing and technology services company, reported record earnings for its fiscal fourth quarter and cited strong growth in new business.
Net earnings for the quarter ending Sept. 30 rose to $28 million, or 53 cents a share, from $25 million, or 45 cents a share in the prior year period.

Rosemont, Ill.-based Comdisco, which provides asset management, computer and computer equipment leasing, and technology integration services, reported revenue of $728 million compared with $584 million for the prior year period.
Comdisco Chairman Jack Slevin attributed the results to $2.6 billion in new business contracts and $769 million in new lease volume. Several other activities also contributed to growth, he said.

In the past year, the company formed an alliance with Asset Software International Corp. of Canada to provide asset management software and services worldwide, and repurchased $80 million or 3.7 million shares of common stock.

For the year ended Sept. 30, Comdisco reported revenue of $2.4 billion compared with $2.2 billion for the prior year. Net earnings grew to $106 million, or $2 a share, compared with $96 million, or $1.73 a share, from last year.
